title: Expose proposed, running, failed, and completed agent actions
problemCues: Assistant proposes edits or runs tools while the user watches a working surface
preconditions: Actions can be typed and cancelled
decision: Give every agent operation distinct proposed/running/failed/completed states with explicit recovery. Do not collapse failures into a chat apology without a retry path on the artifact.
tradeoffs: More UI states to design and test
exceptions: Purely informational spoken summaries with no side effects
example: AI review proposed field change brief
validatedBy: Usability contract includes failure and retry objects
